summary.intent: Open a PR for the release tag-push fix using the `entire` tool, then address a high-severity 'slop' finding raised on trail #198 saying the test harness and test coverage didn't match the new full-ref tag push.
summary.outcome: PR #442 was opened as a draft via `entire trail link`, then the fake git in the release harness was updated to accept full `refs/tags/` refspecs and a regression test for a tag/branch name collision was added (verified failing on old code). Changes were committed and pushed; the e2e suites were run but their results are not shown in the transcript.

repo: Release e2e tests use a fake git defined as a shell script in crates/callisto-cli/tests/common/release_harness.rs; `record_pushed_tag()` must strip `refs/tags/` and any `:dst` suffix from the refspec to match the new push form.

Release-related e2e test targets in callisto-cli: durable_release_e2e_tests, release_command_e2e_tests, release_forge_publish_e2e_tests, release_hardening_tests, provider_flag_contract_tests, release_real_registry_e2e_tests, stageable_targets_e2e_tests, shallow_clone_e2e_tests, nested_cargo_workspace_e2e_tests.
callisto_fixtures::git provides helpers (run_git, init_repo, GitRunner) usable for real-git tests of push_tag against a bare remote.
A bare `git push origin v1` is ambiguous ('src refspec v1 matches more than one') when a branch shares the tag's name; pushing `refs/tags/v1` avoids it.

code.finding: Replaced the unit test the_push_names_the_tag_ref_in_full with a_tag_pushes_when_a_branch_has_the_same_name, an integration-style test using a real bare remote and a same-named branch.
record_pushed_tag in the fake git now normalizes its argument via `${1#refs/tags/}` and `${1%%:*}` before recording.

workflow: Linking a branch to an Entire trail (`entire trail link <id>`) causes Entire to open the PR as a draft; title/body are then set with `gh pr edit`.
`entire trail finding list <id> --json` retrieves review findings for a trail.
Validate a regression test by temporarily reverting the fix to confirm it fails, then restoring the fix.
Run the broader e2e suites, not just unit tests, when changing behavior that fake test doubles mimic.

friction: The earlier PR claimed only tag unit tests, clippy and fmt passed; the full CLI e2e suite was not run, which led to the high slop finding.
The first cargo test invocation looped to build `--test` flags in a variable and had to be retried with an explicit command.
The first inline python heredoc edit attempt for tag.rs had to be redone by writing edit.py to a file and running it.
open_items: Remaining planned fixes: receipt saying `published` for an already-published version, BOM/CRLF loss, cargo registry `url`, and yarn `--registry`.
The results of the full release e2e suite run after the harness fix are not shown in the transcript and should be confirmed.
